labels.note: D/SL/CB round half up to the nearest cent (rule 36); policy rounds up (ceil); R rule 5.

labels.note: D/SL cut mid-word (maxlen 7 gives 'hello-w'); CB rule 56 drops the split word and hard-cuts a too-long first word, as the policy does; R rules 14-15.

labels.label: D:wrong SL:wrong CB:partial R:right
labels.note: D/SL return empty text. CB returns 'untitled' (e.g. '!!!', maxlen 0) but says 'untitled' is then cut to maxlen ('untit'), whereas the policy returns the full 'untitled'; R rule 16.

labels.label: D:right SL:right CB:right R:right
labels.note: All sheets: a check value of 10 gives 'X' (D rule 26; R rule 36).

labels.label: D:partial SL:partial CB:partial R:right
labels.note: D/SL/CB ignore hyphens and spaces only (rule 27), but return NULL for letters, dots and other characters (rule 28), where the policy ignores them; R rule 32.

labels.label: D:wrong SL:wrong CB:wrong R:right
labels.note: D/SL return NULL for more than 9 digits (rule 29); CB rule 29 also keeps 'more than 9 digits ... NULL'; policy uses the first 9; R rule 33.

labels.label: D:wrong SL:wrong CB:wrong R:right
labels.note: D/SL/CB add the exact minutes (rule 63, e.g. '09:00'+30 gives '09:30'), with no rounding up to 15-minute blocks; R rule 38.

labels.label: D:wrong SL:wrong CB:wrong R:right
labels.note: D wraps past midnight. SL/CB rule 64 caps at 23:59, but rule 65 still drops whole days ('10:00'+1440 gives '10:00'), which conflicts with the cap (policy gives 23:59); R rule 40.

labels.label: D:wrong SL:wrong CB:right R:right
labels.note: D/SL return NULL when old is 0 (rule 79); CB rule 79 returns 0.0; R rule 42.

labels.label: D:wrong SL:wrong CB:wrong R:right
labels.note: D returns NULL for counts other than 10 (and strips a leading 1). SL/CB rule 87 returns the input unchanged, but rule 88 still says NULL for other counts, and rules 90 and 94 say NULL, so the sheet conflicts with itself; R rule 47.

labels.label: D:partial SL:partial CB:partial R:right
labels.note: D/SL/CB leave out out-of-range, NULL and non-numeric ratings (rules 97-99), but count numeric text such as '4' (rule 100), which the policy ignores; R rule 48.

labels.label: D:wrong SL:wrong CB:wrong R:right
labels.note: D/SL/CB take a plain average of all ratings (rule 96), with no trimming; R rule 50.

labels.label: D:right SL:right CB:right R:right
labels.note: Halves round up (rule 102, 2,3,3,3 gives 2.8); R rule 51.
